claim: Nike reports $39 billion in revenue for fiscal Q3 2024
summary: Nike's fiscal Q3 2024 quarter revenue was about $12.4 billion, not $39 billion. $39 billion is near the 9-month total, not the Q3 quarter.

sub_claims.text: Nike had a reportable fiscal Q3 2024 period.
sub_claims.note: From general knowledge Nike operates on a May year-end and had a fiscal Q3 2024 quarter ended February 2024 for which it reported results.

sub_claims.text: Nike's revenue for fiscal Q3 2024 alone was $39 billion.
sub_claims.stated_text: $39 billion in revenue for fiscal Q3 2024
sub_claims.note: Nike quarterly revenue is about $12-13 billion; fiscal Q3 2024 was about $12.4 billion. Annual FY2024 was about $51 billion, so $39 billion cannot be a single quarter; ~$39 billion approximates the 9-month year-to-date total.
